# Agent Evidence Vectors

> Test an agent-evidence verifier against saved records with known outcomes.

Each corpus has a manifest naming its source revision, digest and expected outcomes. The harness records conformance separately from reason-code agreement. Use the report's external-rail and execution fields to check that the named verifier ran.

## Start

- [Quickstart](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/README.md): Install the released verifier and replay a corpus.
- [Install and cite](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/DISTRIBUTION.md): Package routes, release tag and corpus identifiers.
- [Corpus guide](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/guides/corpora.md): Choose a format and check which readers support it.

## Run your verifier

- [Verifier contract](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/reference/verifier-contract.md): Invocation, exit status, JSON output, key policy and comparison rules.
- [Runner guide](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/guides/runner.md): GitHub Action inputs, reports and supported corpora.
- [Run reporting](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/guides/report-run.md): Share a report or investigate a disagreement.

## Check evidence

- [Release verification](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/reference/release-verification.md): Recompute digests and check signatures and timestamp proofs.
- [Corpus measurements](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/research/corpus-measurements.md): What the fixtures force and how CI measures it.
- [Outside results](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/RUNS.md): The outside implementation run ledger.
- [Independence record](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/research/independence.md): Blind and directed runs, source pins and reproduction records.

## Source and contributions

- [Repository layout](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/docs/reference/layout.md): Verifier, harness, generators and records.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Add vectors, readers or corpora.
- [Citation metadata](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Current release and archive identifier.
- [Security](https://github.com/probityai/agent-evidence-vectors/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Report a vulnerability.
- [Probity projects](https://github.com/probityai): Vocabulary, records, verification, admission and the evidence atlas.
